description: This file defines the GatewayEndpointID enum with static methods to generate stable identifiers and descriptive strings for NWEndpoint instances, including normalization of service names for consistent IDs.

methods.name: stableID
methods.description: Generates a stable string ID for a given NWEndpoint, normalizing service names to ensure consistency.

methods.name: prettyDescription
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the NWEndpoint, decoding any special escape sequences.

methods.name: normalizeServiceNameForID
methods.description: Decodes a raw service name, normalize whitespace, and trim to produce a consistent service name for IDs.
